metadata.description: Site check skills for AI coding agents: AI crawler access, domain and certificate expiry, Core Web Vitals.

plugins.name: site-check-skills
plugins.description: Three real website checks your agent can run: are GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot blocked (robots.txt plus a real fetch), when do the domain and TLS certificate expire (registry RDAP), and do real visitors pass Core Web Vitals (PageSpeed Insights). Zero dependencies, Node 20+.
